Community is individuals, families, groups, and social organizations and/or community organizations. 33. Human trafficking is the act of recruiting, transporting, sheltering, sending, transferring, or receiving a person by threat of violence, use of violence, abduction, confinement, forgery, fraud, abuse of power or vulnerable position, debt bondage or giving payments or benefits, so as to obtain consent from the person holding control over that person, whether conducted within the country or between countries, for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in the person being exploited. 34. Protection is any effort aimed at providing a sense of security to victims carried out by the family, advocates, social institutions, police, prosecution, courts, or other parties either temporarily or based on court determination. 35. Protection of women is any effort made to ensure the fulfillment of women's rights as a form of respect for human rights. 36. Implementation of Child Protection is a series of activities carried out by the Regional Government, community, and parents, which are aimed at preventing, reducing risk, and handling victims of acts of violence, exploitation, maltreatment and neglect of children. 37. Child Protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, be healthy, intelligent, grow and develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from neglect, violence and discrimination. 38. Violence Against Women is any act based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, economic, social exploitation including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of freedom arbitrarily, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. 39. Violence Against Children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, and psychologically. 40. Domestic Violence Against Women and Children is any act against a woman and child that results in misery or suffering physically, sexually, psychologically, economically and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts of coercion or deprivation of freedom unlawfully within the scope of the household. 41. Exploitation of Children is any act involving children in activities that can harm the welfare and growth and development or endanger the safety of children with the aim of enabling others to obtain economic, sexual, social, or political benefits, including if therein there is a restriction or elimination of opportunities for children to obtain their rights. 42. Maltreatment of Children is any action towards children, including placing children in situations that can cause adverse impacts on the welfare, safety, dignity and development of children. 43. Assistance is social work that has professional competence in the field. 44. Child Neglect is any act of neglecting the fulfillment of basic needs, care, and maintenance so as to disrupt or hinder the growth and development of children, including leaving children in dangerous situations. 45. Prevention is the effort of the Regional Government and community in creating conditions that can prevent the occurrence of violence, maltreatment, exploitation and neglect of children. 46. Risk Reduction is early action towards children and their families who are in vulnerable or at-risk situations of experiencing various forms of violence, maltreatment, exploitation, and neglect. 47. Handling is an action that includes identification, rescue, rehabilitation and reintegration of children who become victims of violence, maltreatment, exploitation, and or neglect. 48. Care Environment is care by parents and care outside parental care. Care outside parental care consists of care by foster parents or adoptive parents as well as care in institutions such as orphanages or child social care institutions or other similar names. 49. PATBM is a movement from a network or group of citizens at the community level who work in a coordinated manner to achieve the goals of child protection. 50. Regional Long-Term Development Plan hereinafter abbreviated as RPJPD is a regional development planning document for a period of 20 (twenty) years. 51. Regional Medium-Term Development Plan hereinafter referred to as RPJMD is a regional development planning document for a period of 5 (five) years. 52. Safe house is a temporary residence used to provide protection to victims in accordance with determined operational standards. 53. Child Participation Forum / Regional child forum is an organization that accommodates the aspirations of children and/or groups of children in Tanggamus Regency. 54. Repatriation is an effort to return Women and Children Victims of Violence from abroad to the debarkation point/entry point or receiving area to the area of origin. 55. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite witnesses and/or victims with the family, substitute family, or community that can provide protection and fulfill the needs of witnesses and/or victims. 56. Women's Protection Service Provider Institution is a government-owned institution or legally incorporated community institution that makes efforts to Protect Women from violence, whether in the implementation of policies, activities, or administration in the provision of services
57. Alternative care is child care carried out by Child Social Welfare Institutions. 59. Child participation is the involvement of children in the decision-making process and enjoying changes relating to their lives either directly or indirectly which is carried out with the consent and will of the child based on awareness and understanding. 60.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S AND CHILDREN'S PROTECTION I. GENERAL.

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming increasingly complex along with the influence of technological developments. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as a protector of its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women and continue to maintain their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic and inseparable manner. Community services are the frontline when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

II. ARTICLE BY ARTICLE

Article 10

(1) Other forms of violence as referred to in Article 4 letter f constitute threats of violence and coercion.

(2) Threats of violence as referred to in paragraph (1) include any unlawful act in the form of speech, writing, images, symbols, or body movements, with or without using means that create fear or restrict a person's fundamental freedom.

(3) Coercion as referred to in paragraph (1) includes a situation where a person/victim is ordered to do something in such a way that the person does something contrary to their own will.

Article 32

In the event of violence against Women and Children, sanctions shall be imposed in accordance with the provisions of Laws and Regulations.

Article 16

The obligation of family and/or parents as referred to in Article 13 letter d, who legally have full responsibility to prevent all forms of violence and protect women and children as family members.

Article 26

(1) The Regional Government establishes partnerships with the business sector and mass media in the protection of women and children from acts of violence in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

(2) Partnership with the business sector as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out through:

a. Notification of employment opportunity information for women and children victims of violence;
b. Education and training for women and children victims of violence.
(3) Partnership with mass media as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out through the dissemination of information and educational materials that are beneficial from social, cultural, educational, religious, and health aspects of women and children by taking into account the best interests of women and children victims of violence.

Article 5

Physical violence as referred to in Article 4 letter a constitutes an act that results in pain accompanied by injury, wounds or defects on the body, miscarriage, loss of consciousness and/or causes death of women and/or children.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S AND CHILDREN'S PROTECTION I. GENERAL.

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming increasingly complex along with the influence of technological developments. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as a protector of its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women and continue to maintain their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic and inseparable manner. Community services are the frontline when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S AND CHILDREN'S PROTECTION I. GENERAL.

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming increasingly complex along with the influence of technological developments. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as a protector of its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women and continue to maintain their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic and inseparable manner. Community services are the frontline when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S AND CHILDREN'S PROTECTION I. GENERAL.

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming increasingly complex along with the influence of technological developments. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as a protector of its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women and continue to maintain their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic and inseparable manner. Community services are the frontline when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

Article 28

a. Coordination
b. Guidance
c. Education and Training
d. Monitoring and Evaluation
(2) The implementation of coordination as referred to in paragraph (1) letter a shall be conducted among stakeholders on a cross-sectoral basis with Regional Apparatus, and Community institutions in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S AND CHILDREN'S PROTECTION I. GENERAL.

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming increasingly complex along with the influence of technological developments. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as a protector of its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women and continue to maintain their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic and inseparable manner. Community services are the frontline when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S AND CHILDREN'S PROTECTION I. GENERAL.

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming increasingly complex along with the influence of technological developments. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as a protector of its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women and continue to maintain their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic and inseparable manner. Community services are the frontline when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

(4) The implementation of education and training as referred to in paragraph (1) letter c shall be provided to women and children who become victims as an effort to improve the physical and mental condition of women and children in fulfilling their rights and needs by the competent Regional Apparatus, Vocational Training Centers and other related Agencies.
(5) The implementation of guidance and supervision towards women and children who become victims as referred to in paragraph (2), paragraph (3) and paragraph (4) shall be carried out through monitoring and evaluation of the targets to be achieved.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S AND CHILDREN'S PROTECTION I. GENERAL.

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming increasingly complex along with the influence of technological developments. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as a protector of its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women and continue to maintain their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic and inseparable manner. Community services are the frontline when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

Community is individuals, families, groups, and social organizations and/or community organizations. 33. Human trafficking is the act of recruiting, transporting, sheltering, sending, transferring, or receiving a person by threat of violence, use of violence, abduction, confinement, forgery, fraud, abuse of power or vulnerable position, debt bondage or giving payments or benefits, so as to obtain consent from the person holding control over that person, whether conducted within the country or between countries, for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in the person being exploited. 34. Implementation of Child Protection is a series of activities carried out by the Regional Government, community, and parents, which are aimed at preventing, reducing risk, and handling victims of acts of violence, exploitation, maltreatment and neglect of children. 37. Child Protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, be healthy, intelligent, grow and develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from neglect, violence and discrimination. 38. Violence Against Women is any act based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, economic, social exploitation including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of freedom arbitrarily, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. 39. Violence Against Children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, and psychologically. 40. Domestic Violence Against Women and Children is any act against a woman and child that results in misery or suffering physically, sexually, psychologically, economically and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts of coercion or deprivation of freedom unlawfully within the scope of the household. 41. Exploitation of Children is any act involving children in activities that can harm the welfare and growth and development or endanger the safety of children with the aim of enabling others to obtain economic, sexual, social, or political benefits, including if therein there is a restriction or elimination of opportunities for children to obtain their rights. 42. CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S AND CHILDREN'S PROTECTION I. GENERAL.

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming increasingly complex along with the influence of technological developments. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as a protector of its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women and continue to maintain their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic and inseparable manner. Community services are the frontline when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S AND CHILDREN'S PROTECTION I. GENERAL.

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming increasingly complex along with the influence of technological developments. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as a protector of its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women and continue to maintain their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic and inseparable manner. Community services are the frontline when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S AND CHILDREN'S PROTECTION I. GENERAL.

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming increasingly complex along with the influence of technological developments. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as a protector of its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women and continue to maintain their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic and inseparable manner. Community services are the frontline when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S AND CHILDREN'S PROTECTION I. GENERAL.

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming increasingly complex along with the influence of technological developments. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as a protector of its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women and continue to maintain their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic and inseparable manner. Community services are the frontline when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S AND CHILDREN'S PROTECTION I. GENERAL.

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming increasingly complex along with the influence of technological developments. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as a protector of its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women and continue to maintain their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic and inseparable manner. Community services are the frontline when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S AND CHILDREN'S PROTECTION I. GENERAL.

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming increasingly complex along with the influence of technological developments. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as a protector of its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women and continue to maintain their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic and inseparable manner. Community services are the frontline when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

Part One

Prevention of violence against women and children

Article 26

(1) The Regional Government establishes partnerships with the business sector and mass media in the protection of women and children from acts of violence in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

(2) Partnership with the business sector as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out through:

a. Notification of employment opportunity information for women and children victims of violence;
b. Education and training for women and children victims of violence.
(3) Partnership with mass media as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out through the dissemination of information and educational materials that are beneficial from social, cultural, educational, religious, and health aspects of women and children by taking into account the best interests of women and children victims of violence.

Article 3

The Scope in this Regional Regulation is as follows: a. Forms of Violence against Women and Children b. Rights of Victims of Acts of Violence Against Women and Children c. Obligations and Responsibilities

d. Protection of Women and Children

e. Cooperation, Partnership and Empowerment

f. Guidance and Supervision

g. Child Friendly Regency (KLA) and Parahita Ekapraya Award (APE)

Article 24

The provision of services to victims is carried out with principles, among others free of charge, fast, safe, empathetic, non-discriminatory, easily accessible and confidential.

Article 28

(1) The regional government shall carry out Guidance and Supervision through:

a. Coordination
b. Guidance
c. Education and Training
d. Monitoring and Evaluation
(2) The implementation of coordination as referred to in paragraph (1) letter a shall be conducted among stakeholders on a cross-sectoral basis with Regional Apparatus, and Community institutions in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.
(3) The implementation of Guidance as referred to in paragraph (1) letter b towards women and children who become victims through guidance on religious values and social values, Counseling, Social Rehabilitation, and Social Assistance by the competent Regional Apparatus together with other related Agencies.
(4) The implementation of education and training as referred to in paragraph (1) letter c shall be provided to women and children who become victims as an effort to improve the physical and mental condition of women and children in fulfilling their rights and needs by the competent Regional Apparatus, Vocational Training Centers and other related Agencies.
(5) The implementation of guidance and supervision towards women and children who become victims as referred to in paragraph (2), paragraph (3) and paragraph (4) shall be carried out through monitoring and evaluation of the targets to be achieved.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S AND CHILDREN'S PROTECTION I. GENERAL.

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming increasingly complex along with the influence of technological developments. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as a protector of its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women and continue to maintain their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic and inseparable manner. Community services are the frontline when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S AND CHILDREN'S PROTECTION I. GENERAL.

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming increasingly complex along with the influence of technological developments. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as a protector of its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women and continue to maintain their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic and inseparable manner. Community services are the frontline when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S AND CHILDREN'S PROTECTION I. GENERAL.

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming increasingly complex along with the influence of technological developments. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as a protector of its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women and continue to maintain their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic and inseparable manner. Community services are the frontline when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S AND CHILDREN'S PROTECTION I. GENERAL.

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming increasingly complex along with the influence of technological developments. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as a protector of its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women and continue to maintain their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic and inseparable manner. Community services are the frontline when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S AND CHILDREN'S PROTECTION I. GENERAL.

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming increasingly complex along with the influence of technological developments. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as a protector of its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women and continue to maintain their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic and inseparable manner. Community services are the frontline when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S AND CHILDREN'S PROTECTION I. GENERAL.

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming increasingly complex along with the influence of technological developments. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as a protector of its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women and continue to maintain their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic and inseparable manner. Community services are the frontline when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S AND CHILDREN'S PROTECTION I. GENERAL.

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming increasingly complex along with the influence of technological developments. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as a protector of its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women and continue to maintain their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic and inseparable manner. Community services are the frontline when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

II. ARTICLE BY ARTICLE

Article 15

(1) The obligations and responsibilities of the private sector and community as referred to in Article 13 letters b and c, are administered in the form of participation of the private sector and community.

(2) Forms of participation of the private sector and community as referred to in paragraph (1), include:

a. Preventing acts of violence against women and children; b. Providing information and/or reporting acts of violence against women and children to law enforcement or authorized parties; and
c. Participating in the handling of victims of violence. (3) Forms of participation of the private sector and community as referred to in paragraph (2), are carried out responsibly in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

Article 16

The obligation of family and/or parents as referred to in Article 13 letter d, who legally have full responsibility to prevent all forms of violence and protect women and children as family members.

Article 32

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S AND CHILDREN'S PROTECTION I. GENERAL.

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming increasingly complex along with the influence of technological developments. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as a protector of its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women and continue to maintain their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic and inseparable manner. Community services are the frontline when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

II. ARTICLE BY ARTICLE

Article 26

(1) The Regional Government establishes partnerships with the business sector and mass media in the protection of women and children from acts of violence in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

(2) Partnership with the business sector as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out through:

a. Notification of employment opportunity information for women and children victims of violence;
b. Education and training for women and children victims of violence.
(3) Partnership with mass media as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out through the dissemination of information and educational materials that are beneficial from social, cultural, educational, religious, and health aspects of women and children by taking into account the best interests of women and children victims of violence.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S AND CHILDREN'S PROTECTION I. GENERAL.

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming increasingly complex along with the influence of technological developments. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as a protector of its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women and continue to maintain their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic and inseparable manner. Community services are the frontline when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

Article 26

(1) The Regional Government establishes partnerships with the business sector and mass media in the protection of women and children from acts of violence in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

(2) Partnership with the business sector as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out through:

a. Notification of employment opportunity information for women and children victims of violence;
b. Education and training for women and children victims of violence.
(3) Partnership with mass media as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out through the dissemination of information and educational materials that are beneficial from social, cultural, educational, religious, and health aspects of women and children by taking into account the best interests of women and children victims of violence.

Article 15

(1) The obligations and responsibilities of the private sector and community as referred to in Article 13 letters b and c, are administered in the form of participation of the private sector and community.

(2) Forms of participation of the private sector and community as referred to in paragraph (1), include:

a. Preventing acts of violence against women and children; b. Providing information and/or reporting acts of violence against women and children to law enforcement or authorized parties; and
c. Participating in the handling of victims of violence. (3) Forms of participation of the private sector and community as referred to in paragraph (2), are carried out responsibly in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

Article 24

The provision of services to victims is carried out with principles, among others free of charge, fast, safe, empathetic, non-discriminatory, easily accessible and confidential.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S AND CHILDREN'S PROTECTION I. GENERAL.

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming increasingly complex along with the influence of technological developments. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as a protector of its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women and continue to maintain their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic and inseparable manner. Community services are the frontline when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S AND CHILDREN'S PROTECTION I. GENERAL.

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming increasingly complex along with the influence of technological developments. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as a protector of its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women and continue to maintain their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic and inseparable manner. Community services are the frontline when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S AND CHILDREN'S PROTECTION I. GENERAL.

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming increasingly complex along with the influence of technological developments. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as a protector of its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women and continue to maintain their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic and inseparable manner. Community services are the frontline when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S AND CHILDREN'S PROTECTION I. GENERAL.

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming increasingly complex along with the influence of technological developments. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as a protector of its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women and continue to maintain their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic and inseparable manner. Community services are the frontline when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

CHAPTER VII

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

Article 32

In the event of violence against Women and Children, sanctions shall be imposed in accordance with the provisions of Laws and Regulations.

Article 28

(1) The regional government shall carry out Guidance and Supervision through:

a. Coordination
b. Guidance
c. Education and Training
d. Monitoring and Evaluation
(2) The implementation of coordination as referred to in paragraph (1) letter a shall be conducted among stakeholders on a cross-sectoral basis with Regional Apparatus, and Community institutions in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.
(3) The implementation of Guidance as referred to in paragraph (1) letter b towards women and children who become victims through guidance on religious values and social values, Counseling, Social Rehabilitation, and Social Assistance by the competent Regional Apparatus together with other related Agencies.
(4) The implementation of education and training as referred to in paragraph (1) letter c shall be provided to women and children who become victims as an effort to improve the physical and mental condition of women and children in fulfilling their rights and needs by the competent Regional Apparatus, Vocational Training Centers and other related Agencies.
(5) The implementation of guidance and supervision towards women and children who become victims as referred to in paragraph (2), paragraph (3) and paragraph (4) shall be carried out through monitoring and evaluation of the targets to be achieved.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S AND CHILDREN'S PROTECTION I. GENERAL.

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming increasingly complex along with the influence of technological developments. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as a protector of its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women and continue to maintain their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic and inseparable manner. Community services are the frontline when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S AND CHILDREN'S PROTECTION I. GENERAL.

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming increasingly complex along with the influence of technological developments. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as a protector of its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women and continue to maintain their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic and inseparable manner. Community services are the frontline when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.
